key_updates.summary: Ron resumes substantive correspondence October 23, stating he has been out of office, is working on Carney items, and asking whether landlord work passed inspection. At 8:11 AM PDT he cites a site report from Tuesday that landlord work is unfinished; at 10:38 AM he says it remains incomplete as of one minute earlier, says there will be no CO until completion, and promises a closeout timeframe without supplying dates. This is contractor-reported status, not City confirmation or proof of completed Carney work.

Scott's 10:29 AM reply challenges the stale Tuesday site report, asks about Thursday attendance, and explicitly directs Carney to finish its own work while the landlord date is obtained. He states Carney work is still unfinished and there is no confirmed electrician date, so immediate landlord completion would not alone make the project ready for CO. This is direct franchisor correspondence identifying separate remaining contractor and landlord dependencies.

Troy at 6:00 AM says he cannot make an '8:30 am call tomorrow' but will supply an update/timeline. Scott at 10:39 AM corrects the weekly call to '2:30 est like always' and requests Carney attendance. Troy at 10:45 AM says it was a typo, writes 'I cannot not be on the call' and promises updates ASAP. Preserve that ambiguous double negative rather than claim confirmed attendance/nonattendance. At 11:37 AM Scott asks where the update is, saying he expected it before the call. No promised timeline or actual attendance verification located.
Ron asks to discuss Scott's 'choice words' separately; Scott offers a Google Meet around training/customer commitments. This exchange does not supply work completion dates.

At 11:32 AM Bharath asks Alex whether stair work can finish by Tuesday (October 27) and states readiness to call inspection. At 11:45 AM Bharath tells the contractor/corporate thread 'Landlord will be done Monday night' (October 26). Record the later owner-reported target; no new direct Alex confirmation, stair inspection booking/pass or final CO located.

No firm Carney itemwise completion dates, electrician appointment, original supporting receipts, direct City response/inspection clearance or CO located. No new bank/insurance, Onesta, Thomas Sign, GPN, Bay Alarm, Motion PG or Read.ai email located after the prior cutoff. Earlier insurance documentation and sign-vendor ACH backup requests remain unresolved in searched correspondence.

Times presented in America/Los_Angeles (PDT). Scott's source says '2:30 est'; prior user-established weekly local meeting time is 11:30 AM PDT. Source wording is preserved rather than silently altering timezone labels.

The later Monday-night landlord completion statement is the owner's report, not independently verified direct landlord commitment, physical completion or City approval. It is more recent than the owner's Tuesday request.
